comment: Independent display.c flush_screen() and wintty.c docorner() witness under the UTF-8 Enhanced1 symset. tty_print_glyph() sends UTF-8 floor glyphs through g_pututf8(), which recorder patch 006 does not mirror, so each cell keeps the last ASCII glyph flushed there. With the default leap runmode a rush flushes only every seventh move, so the pet glyphs buffered and replaced between flushes never reach the shadow cell. The ? help menu is a corner window; its dismissal runs docorner(), which blanks the stale cells it covers.
